sources.title: GitHub - nelsonramosua/miniAI: Feed-forward neural network in pure C ...
sources.snippet: miniAI is an educational implementation of an artificial neural network built entirely from scratch in pure C, with no external machine learning library dependencies. The project demonstrates the fundamentals of deep learning through a complete feed-forward architecture, including forward propagation, backpropagation, L2 regularization, gradient clipping, and hyperparameter optimization.
